_comment: Version/date-pinned datasets that `biobtree check --all` CANNOT detect new releases for. The built-in check only inspects the frozen pinned URL (e.g. string v12.0, bindingdb _202606_), so a brand-new version at a NEW url is invisible to it, and a removed old file 404s at download time. This manifest defines, per dataset, how to discover the latest upstream version and where our pinned version lives in conf. Run: python3 src/scripts/version_check/check_versions.py [--fix]

bindingdb.note: monthly release; only the latest month is kept, so a stale month 404s

string.note: bulk flat files can lag the web version (v12.5 web, v12.0 bulk). Fixing means bumping path + downloadUrlLinks/Aliases/Info + data_version.

patent.note: useLocalFile=yes (manual download); SureChEMBL is monthly — verify + re-fetch

drugcentral.note: pinned 2021_09_01; DrugCentral rarely re-releases; RED license (free-tier only)

gnomad_constraint.note: gnomAD v4.1 current; bump on a new major gnomAD release
